title: Gibasis Callisto - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Rare Purple Trailing Plant
description:
A brand-new, rare trailing houseplant with dusky purple foliage - bred in Wales in 2025.
KEY FEATURES
• Rare new Gibasis cultivar, bred in 2025 by Avery Rowe in Machynlleth, Wales
• Narrow, pointed leaves in dark greyish purple to reddish brown, with purple-grey undersides
• Vigorous sprawling, trailing habit - perfect for hanging pots and shelves
• Clouds of tiny white flowers, sometimes blushed pink at the tips
• A cross of Gibasis pellucida 'Purple Bridal Veil' and Gibasis 'Jose Puig', named after Jupiter's moon Callisto
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Gibasis
Colour: Purple foliage; small white flowers
Season: Year-round foliage
Growth Habit: Trailing / sprawling
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, indirect light (colour is richest in good light)
Soil: Free-draining houseplant compost
Watering: Keep lightly moist; water when the top 2cm of compost is dry
Spacing: 2-3 plugs per 12cm pot or hanging basket for a fuller look
Height: Low and trailing; stems spill over the pot edge
Hardiness: Tender - keep above 10°C; grow indoors in the UK, or outdoors only in summer
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Pot on into a small pot of houseplant compost on arrival and water lightly.
• Give bright, indirect light; too little light fades the purple colour.
• Do not let it dry out completely, but avoid waterlogging.
• Pinch out the tips to keep it bushy - cuttings root easily.
• Feed monthly in spring and summer with a balanced liquid feed.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
DISPATCH
